review_target: M714 H67 ep35 PCTDA pattern S10 pre-run candidate

decision.decision_basis: The DA algebra and pattern statistic are useful, but the current executable lacks a pinned M714 identity, the required four-check GPU-idle gate, predecessor-result admission gates, and an atomic sealed receipt path.
decision.minimum_next_state: M714-r2 exact-SHA contract plus independently reviewed one-shot A800 runner and fail-closed payload gate

positive_findings.finding: The signed-INT8 DA identity is algebraically correct: bit 7 is weighted by -128 and bits 0-6 by +2^b. Independent exhaustive reconstruction covered all 256 scalar codes with zero mismatch.

Equal 5-bit addresses may share one subset-vector read within the same temporal group and bit plane. Their lane masks are disjoint, zero address contributes exactly zero, and keeping the two groups separate avoids applying two group-specific table values to one accumulator in one modeled issue.

A five-weight subset lies in [-640,635], so signed 11-bit storage is sufficient. One unreplicated two-group, ten-output table is 7040 bits (880 bytes), and two configurations fit in one 128x128 macro by a 128x110 physical layout.

The 25-bit internal accumulator is consistent with M518, not a width bug. A conservative bit-plane prefix bound including a Q24 bias is 8,715,008 in magnitude, below signed-25 capacity; final Q24 saturation/event behavior still needs a real miter.

The imported Fixed anchor is real: M518 closes 17 issue cycles per tile and clean service 17N+12 (N1=29, N4=80). M714 also correctly avoids claiming RTL, PPA, energy, full-network or headline results in its prose boundary.

P0.title: No immutable M714 launch authority and no enforced A800 idle gate
evidence: M714 lines 203-213 accept an arbitrary --m366-contract and call M366 validation, but do not pin the canonical M366 contract SHA or an independently expected M714 script SHA.
M366 lines 72-93 validate records inside whichever schema-compatible contract was supplied; they do not require the canonical contract path/hash.
M366 lines 591-605 create the output and enter CUDA without implementing the contract's four consecutive idle checks or scanning for training/eval/profile processes.
P0.risk: A self-consistent alternate workload can be labeled M714, and the current entry point can contend with an active A800 job despite the frozen contract explicitly forbidding that launch.
P0.required_fix: Freeze an M714-r2 contract that pins M714, canonical M366 contract, M366 script and all inputs; use a separately reviewed exact-SHA one-shot runner that performs four consecutive idle/process checks immediately before launch and records them.

P0.title: M714 overwrites predecessor status with PASS without checking numeric or population gates
evidence: M714 lines 294-340 load the M366 payload, unconditionally set PASS_M714 and set pctda_s10_pattern_capture/pctda_issue_opportunity true.
There is no requirement for 10 samples, 45 T10 sites, 450 calls, zero nonfinite inputs, zero signed-Q8 range violations, zero bound violations or zero integer mismatches.
PatternCapture counts x_q after M366 clamps values to [-128,127]; a saturation-bearing diagnostic run can therefore be promoted as an exact opportunity.
P0.risk: A failed or incomplete frozen numeric capture can become a green M714 opportunity receipt, violating the fail-closed and exactness contract.
P0.required_fix: Before any M714 PASS/admission, assert the canonical M366 identity, exact population, all conservation identities and every zero-valued numeric gate. On any failure retain the diagnostic payload but set FAIL/NO_GO and all opportunity admission flags false.

P0.title: No atomic attempt, failure quarantine, member manifest or seal
evidence: M366 lines 594-596 create the canonical output directory before CUDA/model work.
M714 writes the final JSON and path file directly at lines 342-346.
Neither layer emits an attempt token, staging-to-final atomic rename, failure receipt/quarantine, recursive SHA manifest, outer seal or terminal self-check.
P0.risk: A crash leaves a partial directory that blocks a retry, and a later reader cannot distinguish a complete immutable capture from a truncated or modified one.
P0.required_fix: Use a unique consumed attempt, same-filesystem staging directory, failure quarantine, atomic final rename, member SHA256SUMS, outer seal and RUN_COMPLETE only after recursive verification.

P1.title: The self-test proves DA algebra but not checkpoint output equivalence
P1.evidence: M714 lines 56-81 test 256 random weight/input vectors with Python integers. The capture itself only counts addresses and never evaluates the frozen 45 weight tables, bias, Q24 saturation, threshold events, lane-mask broadcast or output identity.
P1.required_fix: Add an independent real-S10 miter over all 45 T10 configurations: dense M518-order reference versus PCTDA, signed25 prefix safety, Q24 saturation, event bits, tags and per-lane/per-output conservation, all zero mismatch.

P1.title: The reported coalesced cycles are a lower bound, not a conservative executable schedule
P1.evidence: The formula charges ceil(unique/P) table reads and a one-cycle floor per bit plane, but charges no address formation/deduplication, 1RW response latency, P-way mask selection/broadcast, 160 accumulator update paths, control tail or candidate-specific output pipeline.
P1.required_fix: Rename the quantity architectural issue lower bound under explicit ideal resources. Do not apply warm-service or >=1.25 gates until a cycle-accurate port schedule or RTL establishes those resources and latency.

P1.title: Warm/cold configuration accounting mixes two incompatible modes and double-counts M518 config
P1.evidence: M518 measures 17N+12 from first config acceptance, so the 12-cycle intercept already crosses the five config beats. M714 then adds another 5 beats to both cold baselines. It also reports 880 external table bytes: direct loading 7040 bits needs 28 256-bit beats and no table build, whereas build-from-weights uses the original five beats plus 64 build cycles.
P1.required_fix: Report separate modes: build-from-1064-bit M518 configuration, or direct 7040-bit table load. Define the measurement endpoints and configuration lifetime, then use one matching fixed denominator.

P1.title: The 45-configuration resident option hides physical capacity and area tax
P1.evidence: M714 reports only resident macro count. Independent recompute gives P1/P2/P4/P8 resident capacity 46/92/184/368 KiB and macro area 0.201/0.403/0.806/1.612 mm2, versus active-state 2.49/4.49/8.49/16.49 KiB.
P1.required_fix: Either charge per-call table construction/load cycles and energy, or put full resident physical capacity, macro area, leakage and ports into every gate. Active <=24 KiB must not validate a resident-45 story.

P1.title: Throughput/area fields are not actionable admission metrics
P1.evidence: The fixed 66,778.235814 um2 value comes from an incomplete quarantined run, while candidate area includes only table macros and omits detector, selection, broadcast, accumulator/control and timing costs. Macro latency/timing/energy are also unproved for this access pattern.
P1.required_fix: Remove the tp/area gate from capture admission or label it non-decisional diagnostic. Reintroduce only after matched Fixed and full PCTDA candidate DC plus bound macro timing/area are independently sealed.

P2.title: Counter conservation is computed but never asserted
P2.required_fix: Assert calls=450, sites=45, tile_bitplanes=8*tiles, histogram sum=2*tile_bitplanes, histogram-weighted sum=distinct addresses, distinct<=nonzero<=32*tile_bitplanes, and coalesced<=uncoalesced for every port/site and aggregate.

P2.title: Tile identity relies silently on chunk size being divisible by 16
P2.required_fix: Assert chunk_columns % 16 == 0 and that padding occurs only on the final chunk of a call, or carry partial tiles across chunks.

P2.title: The self-test comment says exhaustive-pattern although it is randomized
P2.required_fix: Rename it deterministic randomized algebra smoke test, or add the 256-code scalar exhaustion used by this review.

a800_repair_gate: Pin M714 SHA and canonical M366 contract SHA in a new immutable contract.
Use an independently reviewed one-shot runner with four immediate idle checks and collision/attempt control.
Make M366 identity, population, numeric and conservation gates prerequisites for M714 admission.
Commit via staging, failure quarantine, atomic rename, inner manifest, outer seal and terminal verification.
Relabel cycle outputs as ideal-resource lower bounds and separate build-from-weights from direct-table-load cold modes.

admitted_by_this_review: 11-bit table width and independent logical/physical storage arithmetic
M518 17N+12 directed cycle anchor as a denominator fact
not_admitted: RTL, VCS, DC, Formality, STA, power, energy or PPA
